user_story: As a user, I want to see my profile information after logging in so that I can confirm my account details.

positive.title: Successful profile information retrieval after logging in
steps: Wait for the profile page to load.
positive.expected_result: User profile information is displayed correctly on the screen.

positive.title: Profile information integrity verification
steps: Verify that the profile information displayed matches the expected details.
positive.expected_result: Profile information matches the stored account details.

negative.title: Login with invalid credentials
negative.expected_result: Error message is displayed indicating invalid credentials.

negative.title: Access profile information without logging in
steps: Navigate to the profile page directly without logging in.
negative.expected_result: User is redirected to the login page.

edge.title: Login with maximum length username and password
steps: Enter a username and password with the maximum allowed characters.
edge.expected_result: User profile information is displayed correctly without errors.

edge.title: Simultaneous logins from multiple devices
steps: Login from a second device with the same credentials.
edge.expected_result: Profile information can be accessed on both devices simultaneously.
